# skill-quality

Reviews or authors SKILL.md and skill reference files for actionable skill smells and focused repairs. Use when writing, changing, or reviewing a skill.

Ships in the [`skills`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install skills@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add skills@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install skills@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
